approval: Maintainer replied 'approved continue' to one 120-second all-ten event-structure audit without physiological analysis, training or scoring. This approves only that audit, not a numerical rerun or new acquisition.
question: Is the attention/rest refusal consistent with ancillary attention beside otherwise intact observed core phases, and what additional structural issues occur across the whole session-two cohort?
identity: Reuse committed complete ses-02 acquisition identity/path/hash checks. Full recording hashes before and after Status analysis read opaque bytes, including physiological payload, but never decode physiological samples. Both passes must fit within the same 120-second cap; otherwise the attempt fails without retry.
allowed: Technical BDF headers; exact ordered existing frozen and independent Status decoders with explicit ses-02 semantics; aggregate event-family counts, transitions, intact/ambiguous run boundaries, structural segment signatures, attention-group placement and available phase-interval validity categories. Only structure, not label identity, leaves memory.
decoder_policy: Compare full ordered sample/code lists privately. Report decoder refusal or disagreement across all ten rather than choosing a preferred decoder. If decoded lists differ, retain each decoder's separate collapsed structural inventory. A decoder refusal is an audit finding, not permission to alter it. Unexpected I/O, identity, process or resource failures end the attempt without a complete-cohort result.
structural_policy: Immediately collapse direction, answer and condition identities into families. Candidate segments are diagnostic summaries, never qualified trials. Missing, duplicate, interrupted and nonunique phase patterns remain separate. Attention after relax without rest is not automatically proof of a missing rest marker. Never infer, insert, repair, skip or relabel events.
forbidden: sample offsets or ordered event rows
preservation: Hash only enumerated prior marker/aggregate files and frozen code before and after; do not inspect their event rows, targets, predictions or weights. Consume one new exclusive local audit directory outside OneDrive. Leave the failed temporal attempt unchanged.
interpretation: A structural census can motivate a narrowly specified later protocol; it cannot certify trial alignment, prove biological signal, establish cortical origin or authorize decoding. No scientific endpoint is evaluated.
